pages.text: Modules give your $(l:mech/mech)mech$(/l) new abilities: flight, a drill, a blade and extra armour. A mech has four mounts, one module each.

Fit modules in a $(l:mech/mech_hangar)Mech Hangar$(/l)'s console while the mech is parked on the pad: the hangar's gantry arm carries each one to its mount. Every module is built around an Advanced Frame.
pages.title: Fitting them

pages.text: Their parts stay stowed while the mech stands empty. $(l)When you climb in$(), the jet's wings and the armour come out; the drill and the blade come out when you switch them on, and go back when you switch them off or get out.

$(li)$(item)Mech Jet Module$(): Back, Two wings unfold segment by segment behind the back unit, and a nozzle comes out under each thruster, $(l)Flight$(): hold jump in the air to climb, sneak to dive, neither to glide. 120 FE/t in the air
pages.title: What they do

pages.text: $(li)$(item)Mech Drill Module$(): Right arm, The $(l)R$() key slides a drill out under the fist; it turns while on, Digs twice as fast, $(l)3x3$(), and gets the drops of any tier. 40 FE per extra block

$(li)$(item)Mech Blade Module$(): Left arm, The $(l)G$() key slides a glowing blade down the outside of the cuff, $(l)18$() extra damage a blow and $(l)8$() to everything within 2.5 blocks of the target. 160 FE a blow
$(li)$(item)Mech Armor Module$(): Trunk, Steel plates slide onto the shoulders, the chest and the hips, The mech takes $(l)40%$() less damage

The keys are in the controls under $(o)CyberFarm Mech$(). The cockpit display lists every fitted module with its state: the jet READY or THRUST, the drill and blade ON or OFF with their keys, the armour's protection.
pages.title: Using them
